'''Patient 3287''' was an individual who accompanied [[Hendrixen]] on a fishing trip to [[Ganlihk]]. During the trip, the patient became convinced that they were being stalked by a [[zuxu]], and ended up at the [[Londori Mental Facility]] under the care of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[G.L. Kisheb]].<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
